backup.title: Backup & Recovery
backup.subtitle: Full restore package for an empty machine: data/ (DB, master.key, agents, vault…), config/, .env, version.json — not backups/, tmp/, or runtime logs
backup.restoreConfirm: Are you sure you want to restore this backup? Current data will be overwritten.
backup.emptyHint: Create a full backup so you can rebuild EYAS on a blank install from the archive alone (plus a git checkout of the code)
backup.restoreEmptySteps: 1) Install matching version: curl …/install.sh | bash -s -- --version <version from table>  2) Stop server  3) tar -xzf <backup>.tar.gz in install root  4) chmod 600 data/master.key .env  5) eyas start
backup.dest.heading: Offsite destinations
backup.dest.subtitle: Each backup is written locally first, then uploaded to the primary destination (S3/B2, FTP, Dropbox, or SSH).
backup.dest.empty: No remote destinations — backups stay only in data/backups/.
backup.dest.name: Display name
backup.dest.secretsHint: Paste the access keys. You can also type an env var name such as BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY.
